opening.argument: The video presents a crypto-exchange promotion as a walkthrough and real test, not as a completed theft, victim-loss, or impersonation scheme. Its stated purpose is a “full walkthrough, real test, and step-by-step tutorial on how to use promo codes and claim free crypto,” with the reward flow tied to entering a code during sign-up. The on-screen exchange-style page provides an activation control, and a confirmation states that the promo code was activated and crypto was credited to the account. The displayed balance is only an account value, not proof of profit or withdrawal. The presentation also qualifies the offer: it is “not instant free money” and requires conditions, while warning viewers to avoid fake generators, unknown apps, and unlimited-code claims.
